text: You're looking for a sweet treat that fits your goal of reducing sugar intake, and these Chocolate Cherry Chewies are a great option. Made with unsweetened cocoa and low-fat sweetened condensed milk, they provide a rich chocolate flavor without excessive sugar. The tart cherry adds a nice balance of sweetness and flavor. With only 2g of sugar per serving, these chewies are a healthier alternative to traditional baked goods. Plus, they're quick to make and ready in under 35 minutes, fitting your 60-minute time budget.
